title: Secret Lair Commander Deck: Hatsune Miku

paragraphs.text: Hatsune Miku is a Secret Lair Commander Deck that became available for purchase from the Wizards of the Coast webshop secretlair.wizards.com on August 10, 2026.

This is a complete, 100-card green-white Commander deck themed around the the Japanese vocaloid Hatsune Miku , a 16-year-old anime character with long, turquoise twin-tails ( Universes Beyond ). Hatsune Miku was earlier in several Secret Lair drops throughout 2024 and 2025, and is owned by Crypton Future Media . 24 cards in this deck feature new art by Japanese Anime artists. Other reprints have their original card face . They can be identified by the white planeswalker symbol in the lower-left corner of the card, similar to Mystery Booster cards and cards on The List .

The decks is priced at $149.99 USD and printed in the English language only. For this release, Secret Lair introduced a 24-hour order window to help more fans get the deck. Orders placed between Monday, August 10, 2026, 9 a.m. PT and Tuesday, August 11, 2026, 8:59 a.m. PT were certain to be fulfilled. A limited quantity was be available to ship right away, while additional orders placed during the window are expected to ship in May 2027 in North America and June 2027 in the EU and the UK. The backorder threshold was reached 55 minutes after release. Although noting room for improvement, the Secret Lair team considered the experiment a great success.
The contents of this deck were leaked at the end of May 2026, when a customer was sent this deck instead of the Goblin Storm Commander Deck and listed it on eBay.

A matching Hatsune Miku-themed Ultra PRO custom box became available on the release day through the Secret Lair Chaos Vault . It contained a high-end Ultra PRO Alcove deck box , Apex sleeves , and a stitched playmat .
